description: This file defines cryptographic classes and functions for encryption, including SHA-256 hashing, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, and AES encryption/decryption, as well as related utilities for the prplMesh project.

classes.name: sha256
classes.description: Wrapper class for computing SHA-256 hashes.

classes.name: diffie_hellman
classes.description: Class implementing Diffie-Hellman key exchange, supporting key generation, shared secret computation, and key management.

methods.name: update(const uint8_t *message, size_t message_length)
methods.description: Updates the hash with new message data.

methods.name: digest(uint8_t *digest)
methods.description: Calculates and outputs the SHA-256 digest.

methods.name: create_peer_EVPKey(const uint8_t *remote_pubkey, size_t remote_pubkey_length, std::unique_ptr<EVP_PKEY, decltype(&EVP_PKEY_free)> *peerPubKey) const
methods.description: Creates an EVP key from a remote public key string (OpenSSL >= 3.0).

methods.name: compute_key(uint8_t *key, size_t &key_length, const uint8_t *remote_pubkey, size_t remote_pubkey_length) const
methods.description: Computes the shared secret key based on remote public key.

methods.name: pubkey_length() const
methods.description: Returns the length of the public key.

methods.name: nonce() const
methods.description: Returns the nonce used in Diffie-Hellman.

methods.name: nonce_length() const
methods.description: Returns the length of the nonce.

methods.name: kwa_compute(const uint8_t *key, uint8_t *data, uint32_t data_len, uint8_t *kwa)
methods.description: Computes the Key Wrap Attribute (KWA) from HMAC.

methods.name: aes_encrypt(const uint8_t *key, const uint8_t *iv, uint8_t *plaintext, int plen, uint8_t *ciphertext, int &clen)
aes_decrypt(const uint8_t *key, const uint8_t *iv, uint8_t *ciphertext, int clen, uint8_t *plaintext, int &plen)
copy_pubkey(const diffie_hellman &dh, uint8_t *dest)
methods.description: Copies the public key from a diffie_hellman object to a buffer.

methods.name: wps_calculate_keys(const diffie_hellman &dh, const uint8_t *remote_pubkey, size_t remote_pubkey_length, const uint8_t *m1_nonce, const uint8_t *mac, const uint8_t *m2_nonce, uint8_t *authkey, uint8_t *keywrapkey)
methods.description: Calculates WPS secret keys based on Diffie-Hellman exchange and nonces.
